name: morning-report
description: A nightly status of your Claude Code streams, for you and your agents, plus a running catalog of what is going well and what is not

dataDir.title: Data folder
dataDir.description: Where status.md, patterns.md, profile.md and the run files live. ~ is your home folder.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: The model that summarizes each session. A cheap one is enough.

reportModel.title: Status model
reportModel.description: The model that writes the status and the patterns entry from the summaries.

sessionLogsDir.title: Session logs folder
sessionLogsDir.description: Optional folder of <session-id>.md logs to read beside the transcripts. Empty skips it.

notifyCommand.title: Notify command
notifyCommand.description: Optional command run with one message argument when a run finishes or fails. Empty skips it.

gitCommit.title: Commit to git
gitCommit.description: When dataDir is a folder of a git repo, commit it and push after each run.

setupDays.title: Setup scan days
setupDays.description: How many days of sessions /morning-setup counts when it offers to read them, at most 7.

reportHour.title: Report hour
reportHour.description: The hour (0–19) /morning-setup schedule runs the nightly job, then hourly for four hours to retry a failed run.
